description:
Ethereum mainnet on-chain read: the chain id the node reports. Ethereum mainnet eth_chainId: takes no query parameters and returns the chain id the node reports.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_chainid. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "hex": "0x1", "method": "eth_chainId", "ok": true, "result": 1, "service": "x402_chain_reads_v1.eth_chainid"}
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_chainid
